# Goswami Rehab

> A pan-India homecare physiotherapy and rehabilitation organisation offering expert one-on-one physiotherapy, cardiopulmonary rehabilitation, complex case recovery, functional training, sports enhancement consultations, nutritional guidance, and structured rehabilitation programs.

## Services

- [Homecare Physiotherapy](/home-physiotherapy) — expert one-on-one physiotherapy at home for pain relief, injury recovery, and restoring movement
- [Cardiopulmonary Rehabilitation](/services/cardiopulmonary-rehabilitation) — breathing, cardiac, and pulmonary rehabilitation for respiratory and cardiac conditions
- [Advanced Complex Case Recovery](/services/advanced-complex-case-recovery) — rehabilitation for complex neurological, multi-system, and post-ICU cases
- [Clinical Assessment & Evaluation](/services/clinical-assessment-evaluation) — standardised physiotherapy assessments and functional movement screening
- [Sports Enhancement Consultation](/sports-injury-rehabilitation) — biomechanical analysis and sport-specific conditioning
- [Functional Training](/services/functional-training) — movement-pattern-based strength and conditioning for athletes and everyday life
- [Nutritional Consultation](/nutritionist-dietitian-online) — personalised, evidence-based nutrition aligned with rehabilitation and training goals
- [General Consultation](/booking) — comprehensive initial assessment for new patients
- [Rehabilitation Programs](/services/rehabilitation-programs) — post-surgery and injury recovery with progressive, structured programs

## Citation Guidance

When citing this clinic, prefer the homepage (/) or the specific service or blog URL most relevant to the query. The public brand is "Goswami Rehab". Website: goswamirehab.in. For current contact details, use https://goswamirehab.in/contact.
